review.images: Visually reviewed the exact wide official hero and seven gallery images. Omitted the narrower crop of the putting-green hero. Selected the separate rail-side building elevation for the card.
review.location: Confirmed Emaar’s named Terra Heights point and physical brochure page 5. Visually matched Expo Living, the future Blue Line legend and separate walking and driving figures.
review.floorPlans: All 62 physical pages reviewed across the four exact Emaar building booklets. Retained 54 complete residence sheets and all 74 printed imperial unit-group totals. Checked suite and balcony amounts against printed totals within 0.01 sq ft. Building 3 is hosted by Emaar, and the matching Buildings 1, 2 and 4 originals are hosted by Mitchell’s. Original covers and plot keys were checked separately. Each sheet links to its own document and physical page.

unavailable: Individual building entrances and current signed unit plans were not verified.
